GCC.label: GCC (UAE · Saudi · Qatar · Oman · Kuwait · Bahrain)

items.title: Kamco Invest: GCC project awards hit $59.4bn in Q2 2026 (+30% y/y) — KSA jumps 160% q/q to $30bn
items.snippet: Saudi awards surged 53.6% y/y to $30bn (only GCC market to grow q/q), Oman +341.7% to $5.9bn, Kuwait +49.1% to $2bn; UAE eased 5.4% to $20.5bn and Qatar fell to $931m. Oil & gas was the only sector up q/q (+269% to $13.7bn) — the KSA/Oman award wave is where near-term substation and transformer packages will land.

items.title: MEED: UAE firm wins Egypt 500 kV transmission contract
items.snippet: A UAE contractor has won a 500 kV transmission contract on Egypt's grid (MEED, details paywalled) — a GCC-supplier export win into Egypt's EETC build-out and a signal of UAE EPC reach beyond the Gulf.

items.title: Hitachi Energy awards PCC Arabia contract to build HVDC valve manufacturing facility in Dammam (KSA)
items.snippet: Contract signed 13 Jul: production buildings, offices, warehouses and MEP for an HVDC valve plant — Hitachi Energy deepens KSA manufacturing localization; a new HV equipment cluster rising in Dammam.

items.title: BYD Energy Storage wins 11.275 GWh battery supply for Masdar/EWEC 24/7 RTC gigaproject (Abu Dhabi)
items.snippet: Single station of 1,644 MW / 11,275 MWh inside the 5.2 GW solar + 19 GWh RTC project — major downstream demand for MV pad-mount / inverter-duty transformers and switchgear across the storage blocks.

items.title: Saudi Arabia grants ACWA Power exclusive rights to export green hydrogen and derivatives
items.snippet: Reported grant of exclusive rights to ACWA Power for exporting green hydrogen, ammonia, methanol and methane plus renewable-power export projects — a structural move for KSA hydrogen-export economics and the electrolyser / rectifier-transformer chain behind it.
items.src: Al Arabiya / Asharq Business · 7 Jul 2026 [ar] · date unverified

items.title: Masdar & EWEC reach $6.1bn financial close on 5.2 GW solar + 19 GWh BESS 24/7 renewables gigaproject (Abu Dhabi)
items.snippet: World-first gigascale round-the-clock renewables plant: $5.1bn debt from 13 banks plus ~$1bn Masdar equity; construction started Oct 2025, COD 2027. Major forthcoming inverter-duty / step-up transformer and grid-connection substation demand in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Mitsubishi Power wins boiler package for dual-fuel conversion of Jeddah South & Shuqaiq plants (2×2.9 GW, KSA)
items.snippet: صفقة لتحويل محطتي كهرباء جنوب جدة والشقيق إلى الغاز — Mitsubishi Power (via Mitsubishi Corporation Machinery, with Dar Al Bilad Contracting) converts two 2.9 GW HFO plants on the west coast to gas/HFO dual-fuel for SEC — west-coast generation fleet upgrades keep GSU / auxiliary-transformer and BOP electrical scope moving.

items.title: SPPC opens qualification for Round 3 CCGT IPPs (KSA) — next wave of gas-fired GSU / substation packages
items.snippet: Saudi Power Procurement Co launched qualification for the third round of BOO combined-cycle IPPs with carbon-capture readiness, following Rounds 1–2 (eight 1,800 MW plants incl. Taiba, Qassim, Rumah, Nairyah). Upstream signal for the next tranche of GSU transformer and 380 kV grid-connection substation awards.

items.title: KAHRAMAA awards QR 2.2bn ($604m) grid contracts for Dukhan Solar connection — Qatar's largest-ever grid expansion
items.snippet: Qatar's Kahramaa signed EPC contracts worth over QR 2.2bn with Voltage Engineering, Best & Betas Consortium, L&T and LS Cable covering a new 400 kV substation, new/upgraded substations, underground cables and OHLs to tie the Dukhan solar plant into the national grid — fresh Qatar EHV transformer, GIS and accessory scope now in execution.

items.title: H1 2026 GCC electricity-deal roundup: KSA competes for the top spot
items.snippet: أكبر صفقات الكهرباء في دول الخليج خلال النصف الأول من 2026 — Attaqa's roundup of the region's largest H1 power deals, headlined by Siemens Energy's Taweelah C equipment win (2.6 GW) and Saudi substation/EPC packages — a useful digest of Jan–Jun 2026 awards.

items.title: Kuwait MEW close to signing ~$274m Shagaya solar grid-connection contract
items.snippet: الكهرباء الكويتية تقترب من توقيع عقد بنحو 274 مليون دولار لربط محطة تحويل مجمع الشقايا للطاقة المتجددة بعقدة الشويخ — moving Shagaya renewable output onto the national grid; fresh Kuwait HV transformer-station and cable scope.

items.title: EWEC awards 2.6 GW Taweelah C IPP to TAQA-led consortium
items.snippet: EWEC awarded the 2.6 GW Taweelah C gas-fired IPP to TAQA, Aljomaih Energy & Water and Sembcorp; Siemens Energy supplies turbines and main electrical equipment — a major upstream driver of UAE GSU/primary-transformer and substation demand.

items.title: GCC projects market hit by Iran war — contract awards down 9.7%
items.snippet: MEED Projects: GCC awards fell from 84 (Jan) and 80 (Feb) to just 25 in March 2026; Saudi Q1 awards down 51% y/y to $11bn. Near-term EPC slowdown, but grid/energy-security spend is being protected — expect substation packages to keep moving.

items.title: GCCIA & Kuwait Fund sign additional financing to strengthen regional grid
items.snippet: Additional financing agreement signed Jan 2026 to reinforce the GCC interconnection backbone — supports the Iraq link and UAE/Oman expansion works (new 400 kV lines and substation expansions at Ghunan, Al Sila, Salwa).

items.title: TAQA / EWEC reach AED 3.6bn financial close on 1 GW Al Dhafra plant for AI data centres
items.snippet: Abu Dhabi's TAQA with EWEC closed AED 3.6bn financing for the 1 GW Al Dhafra gas plant feeding UAE data centres under the National AI Strategy 2031 — fresh primary-transformer, GIS and accessory demand in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Bahrain (EWA) takes bids for Sitra 400 kV grid substation cable works; Siemens Energy holds $127m substation EPC
items.snippet: Bahrain's Electricity & Water Authority received cable-works bids (Apr 2026) for the new Sitra Industrial Area 400 kV grid substation — the transmission link for the planned 1.2 GW Sitra IWPP. Siemens Energy holds the BD48.1m ($127m) substation EPC (400 kV + 220 kV GIS, 21 kV switchgear). Fresh Bahrain EHV transformer, GIS and accessory scope now moving.

items.title: Saudi Power Procurement signs SAR 11.5bn ($3.07bn) PPA for Rabigh 2 expansion (+2,313.5 MW) — incl. new 380 kV substation
items.snippet: الشركة السعودية للطاقة (SPPC) وقّعت اتفاقية شراء طاقة بقيمة 11.5 مليار ريال لتوسعة محطة رابغ 2 المستقلة، بإضافة قدرة إنتاجية تبلغ 2,313.5 ميجاواط بتقنية الدورة المركبة مع جاهزية لالتقاط الكربون. The project explicitly includes building a new 380 kV substation (ownership later transferred) — large fresh GSU, primary-transformer, 380 kV substation and accessory scope in KSA's Western region.

items.title: SEC signs SAR 5.33bn ($1.42bn) energy-conversion agreement for Rabigh 1 expansion (~1,179 MW)
items.snippet: شركة الكهرباء السعودية وقّعت اتفاقية تحويل طاقة بقيمة 5.33 مليار ريال لتوسعة محطة رابغ 1 بنظام الدورة المركبة في المنطقة الغربية، بقدرة إنتاجية تصل إلى نحو 1,179 ميجاواط. New ~1,179 MW combined-cycle generation in KSA's Western region — fresh primary-transformer, GSU and substation/accessory scope into the pipeline.

items.title: Kuwait MEW signs KWD 84.7m ($275m) 400 kV overhead-line supply & install deal
items.snippet: Kuwait's Ministry of Electricity, Water & Renewable Energy signed a contract to supply and install 400 kV overhead transmission lines valued at KWD 84.667m (~$275m) — fresh Kuwait EHV line/substation pull, with associated transformer and accessory scope.

items.title: Oman (Nama) floats international tender for 800–1,000 MW green-hydrogen power plant
items.snippet: عُمان تطرح مناقصة دولية لإنشاء محطة كهرباء بالهيدروجين الأخضر باستطاعة 800–1000 ميجاواط، مع موعد نهائي لتقديم المقترحات الاستشارية 21 يونيو 2026 — مشروع توليد جديد يجلب طلباً على المحولات الرئيسية والمحطات الفرعية. New Omani generation tender that brings primary-transformer and substation scope into the pipeline.

items.title: GCCIA signs ~$800m agreements to expand UAE link and interconnect Oman
items.snippet: هيئة الربط الكهربائي الخليجي وقّعت اتفاقات بنحو 800 مليون دولار لتوسعة الشبكة مع الإمارات والربط مع عُمان — رفع قدرة الربط مع الإمارات وإضافة محطات ومعوّضات (STATCOM) تدخل الخدمة بحلول نهاية 2027. New 400 kV substation, transformer and reactive-compensation scope across the backbone.

items.title: SEC awards $906m for Afif 380 kV BSP substations + OHTLs
items.snippet: Two bulk-supply-point substations (Afif 1 to Al Gihaz ~$256m, Afif 2 to Al Babtain ~$320m) plus three OHTL packages — integrates NREP renewables into the Saudi grid.

items.title: SEC Namria 380 kV substation EPC awarded to EICO + TBEA — $192m
items.snippet: Energy & Infrastructure Co (EICO) signed with TBEA for the full EPC of SEC's Namria 380 kV substation — a $192m localisation-flavoured award (China-tech + Saudi contractor) adding 380 kV transformer, GIS and accessory scope in KSA.

items.title: UAE power sector hits record $8.9bn in contracts
items.snippet: $1.1bn allocated to substations and control centres; ~$14.3bn of power projects out to tender incl. $1.2bn transmission — EWEC/TAQA expanding 400 kV & 132 kV networks.

items.title: GCCIA starts $700m Oman power grid interconnection
items.snippet: 530 km 400 kV double-circuit line linking Al-Sila (Abu Dhabi) to new Ibri substation, with two new 400 kV substations at Ibri and Al-Baynounah.

items.title: GCCIA awards $220m contracts for Iraq interconnection
items.snippet: Includes a new ~400 kV transformer substation at Wafra, Kuwait, as part of the GCC–Iraq interconnection (≈600 MW to southern Iraq, commissioning Q1 2026).

items.title: DEWA commissions 10 substations, expands grid with AED 8.5bn programme
items.snippet: Dubai Electricity & Water Authority brought 10 new substations online and is rolling out AED 8.5 billion of grid projects — sustained transformer & accessory demand.

items.title: EAG wins TRANSCO Al Bahia Substation EPC (Abu Dhabi)
items.snippet: Ali & Sons / EAG awarded the TRANSCO Al Bahia substation EPC — 2-year build, marking EAG's entry into UAE power infrastructure.

items.title: Aramco awards $41m transformer supply to Saudi Power Transformers
items.snippet: Saudi Power Transformers to deliver transformers to Aramco within 20 months.

items.title: L&T wins 'large' substation orders in UAE & Saudi Arabia
items.snippet: PT&D division: UAE — one 220 kV + three 132 kV substations (incl. Abu Dhabi 220/33 kV grid station); KSA — 380 kV GIS with reactors and 380 kV OHLs. Order band ₹250–500bn ($299m–$598m).

items.title: KAHRAMAA 2026 plan: 198 tenders worth QR21.4bn ($5.9bn); QR8.9bn for transmission
items.snippet: Qatar's 2026 procurement programme spans 198 tenders (~$5.9bn); electricity transmission accounts for QR8.9bn ($2.4bn) incl. new 400/132 kV substations at Al-Wukair and Al-Mashaf plus 400 kV expansion at Ras Laffan, alongside the EPC tender for new 400/132/11, 132/11 and 66/11 kV substations + 400 kV EHV cables (bids closed 14 May). Awards expected through H2 2026 — large Qatar transformer & accessory pull.

items.title: SEC awards SPTC $376m transformer & reactor supply deal
items.snippet: 84-month EHV/HV supply agreement with Saudi Power Transformers Co; SEC may uplift value 40% to ~$452m — major localisation win for KSA manufacturing.

items.title: Kuwait awards Al-Ahleia $110m 400/132/11 kV substation deal
items.snippet: Al-Ahleia won a $110m contract (Apr 2026) for a 400/132/11 kV substation supporting affordable-housing power infrastructure — fresh Kuwait HV transformer and accessory demand now in execution.

items.title: Kuwait expected to award transformer substations contract in Q4 2026
items.snippet: MEW preparing to award a new transformer-substations package — fresh Kuwait HV/MV substation and transformer demand to track into H2.

items.title: Dubai expected to award substations EPC contract in Q3 2026
items.snippet: DEWA moving its ~$150m 13× 132/11 kV substation EPC toward a Q3 award after bid review — primary-transformer and accessory pull into Dubai's grid build.

items.title: DEWA Tawimura 33/11 kV substation award expected this quarter
items.snippet: Re-tendered Dec 2025, bids closed 28 Jan 2026; contract award expected around May–Jun 2026 with completion Q2 2027 — near-term distribution-transformer and accessory demand at Lesaily, Dubai.

items.title: GCC–Oman direct electrical interconnection project launches with USD 700m funding
items.snippet: The direct electrical interconnection project between the GCC grid and Oman was launched with USD 700m in financing, strengthening Gulf energy security and integration, per Asharq Al-Awsat. The link expands cross-border transmission capacity between the GCCIA network and Oman's power system.

items.title: Atlanta Electricals Q1FY27: revenue +48%, Rs 291.68 cr RRVPNL power-transformer order; order book Rs 3,117 cr
items.snippet: Q1 (Apr–Jun 2026) consolidated revenue Rs 466.33 cr (+48% y/y), PAT Rs 46.84 cr, Q1 inflows Rs 972.42 cr; during the quarter Atlanta secured a Rs 291.68 cr order from Rajasthan's RRVPNL for power transformers — the Tier-2 Indian OEM tier keeps compounding alongside TARIL.

items.title: RECPDCL incorporates SPV for 400 kV GIS Solapur/Paranda switching station (Dharashiv, Maharashtra)
items.snippet: Dharashiv Power Transmission Ltd incorporated 21 Jul 2026 as the TBCB/BOOT SPV for a new 400 kV gas-insulated switching station in Dharashiv district; primary elements targeted for COD within 24 months — another 400 kV GIS scheme entering India's bid pipeline.

items.title: TARIL Q1FY27: order inflow trebles to Rs 2,114 cr; record Rs 6,630 cr order book, Rs 23,000 cr enquiry pipeline
items.snippet: Q1 (Apr–Jun 2026) inflows +218% y/y powered by the Rs 1,000 cr+ PGCIL mega-order; unexecuted order book hit a record Rs 6,630 cr (+26% y/y). Changodar expansion completes Aug 2026; Rs 900–1,000 cr backward integration and three Chiyada greenfield plants on track — India's transformer capacity build-out is running at full tilt.

items.title: PGCIL wins India's first pure synchronous-condenser TBCB scheme (Fatehgarh-II, Rajasthan)
items.snippet: LoI for 2× synchronous condensers plus 765/400/220 kV bays at the Fatehgarh-II pooling station — PGCIL's third ISTS-TBCB win of July. FY27 TBCB scoreboard: 6 SPVs transferred, 3 LoIs pending, Adani & Apraava L1 on two more.

items.title: Adani Energy Solutions emerges L1 for its first ISTS-TBCB scheme of FY27 (Andhra Pradesh)
items.snippet: AESL is lowest bidder for a green-hydrogen-linked interstate transmission scheme in AP (bid via RECPDCL); LoI pending — new 765/400 kV substation and transformer scope to follow SPV transfer.

items.title: POWERGRID wins Rajasthan REZ TBCB scheme (Bhadla-III / Ramgarh / Kanpur) — five 500 MVA + three 1,500 MVA ICTs
items.snippet: LoI received 9 Jul 2026: BOOT project heavily transformer-loaded — five 500 MVA 400/220 kV ICTs at Bhadla-III, two 1,500 MVA 765/400 kV + two 500 MVA ICTs at Ramgarh, one 1,500 MVA 765/400 kV ICT at Kanpur; evacuates ~20 GW of Rajasthan REZ renewables, COD by Jan 2029. PGCIL beat Adani Energy and three others — big fresh EHV transformer and accessory pull.

items.title: POWERGRID wins Krishnagiri REZ Phase-I TBCB — two new 765/400 kV substations across three southern states
items.snippet: LoI 10 Jul 2026: BOOT scheme includes two new 765/400 kV substations in Andhra Pradesh plus 765/400 kV lines across AP, Telangana and Karnataka — another large 765 kV-class transformer and reactor demand block entering India's pipeline.

items.title: PGCIL commissions Khavda Phase IV Part E4 (Rs 235 cr) — fourth 1,500 MVA 765/400 kV ICT at Padghe GIS
items.snippet: DOCO 13 Jul 2026: one new 1,500 MVA 765/400 kV ICT energised at Padghe GIS (Maharashtra) with 765/400 kV bays and ~1 km of GIS duct — part of the 7 GW Khavda RE evacuation scheme; UHV-class commissioning tempo stays high.

items.title: India tightens UHV transformer market access: BIS efficiency labelling mandatory for ≥800 kV units from 15 Jul 2026
items.snippet: Under IS 17115:2026 (Part 2), measured no-load/load losses must appear on labels and match the BIS platform or customs clearance can be denied; only three test labs are open and booked through September — a direct compliance gate for transformer exporters to India and a scheduling risk for importers.

items.title: KEC International books Rs 1,180 cr orders — incl. first transmission-line order for data-centre power evacuation in India
items.snippet: KEC's T&D haul (15 Jul 2026) includes its first transmission line built to evacuate power for a private data-centre developer in Western India, plus Middle East / Americas tower supply and 200+ MW solar EPC; YTD intake tops Rs 5,200 cr — the AI/data-centre demand lane has now formally reached Indian T&D EPC.

items.title: India grants 2-year public-procurement exemption to four Chinese-owned transformer/equipment subsidiaries (TBEA, Nanjing, New Northeast, Taikai)
items.snippet: India's Department of Expenditure granted a two-year exemption from Public Procurement Order restrictions to four Indian subsidiaries of Chinese electrical-equipment makers — TBEA Energy India, Nanjing Electric India, New Northeast Electric India and Taikai Electric India — letting them bid on Central-government power tenders without PPO registration (effective 24 Jun 2026). The concrete follow-through on the 3 Jul market selloff — a real competitive shift for domestic transformer OEMs and their accessory supply chain.

items.title: PM Modi inaugurates Rajasthan REZ Phase-III and lays foundation for Phase-IV transmission — Rs 4,645 cr, 5,500 MVA new substation capacity
items.snippet: PM Modi inaugurated the Rajasthan Renewable Energy Zone Phase-III transmission project (606.6 ckm of lines) and laid the foundation stone for Phase-IV (527 ckm of lines + 5,500 MVA of substation capacity to evacuate 5.5 GW of renewables); the two together are valued at over Rs 4,645 cr — fresh EHV transformer, reactor and substation-accessory pull into India's grid build.

items.title: Statcon Energiaa wins MW-class rectifier order for L&T's IOCL Panipat 10 kTPA green-hydrogen plant
items.snippet: Statcon Energiaa will supply indigenous 4 MW IGBT-chopper rectifier blocks (AEG Power Solutions technology) powering L&T Electrolysers' high-pressure alkaline stacks at IOCL's Panipat Refinery green-H₂ project — commissioning Dec 2027, the first concrete step in IOCL's 350 kTPA-by-2030 plan. Fresh rectifier-transformer and power-quality scope, fully Made-in-India.

items.title: TARIL wins 'Ultra Mega' PGCIL transformer order worth over Rs 1,000 cr
items.snippet: Transformers & Rectifiers (India) disclosed on 30 Jun 2026 an order exceeding ₹1,000 cr from Power Grid Corp for manufacture and supply of transformers of various ratings plus associated works, executable over 30 months — one of TARIL's largest wins to date; shares jumped 5–6%.

items.title: India to open power tenders to China-linked OEMs with local factories — Hitachi Energy, CG Power, GE Vernova T&D shares fall up to 10%
items.snippet: On 3 Jul 2026 listed transformer/heavy-electrical OEMs sold off after reports the government will allow Chinese power-equipment makers with factories in India to bid on government tenders for critical power projects — a significant competitive shift for the Indian transformer market and its supplier chain.

items.title: TARIL secures $16.26m US export order for five transformers
items.snippet: TARIL won an export order worth $16,258,352 from PDC AK LPIV, LLC for manufacture and supply of five transformers, delivery by mid-2027 — Indian OEMs increasingly feeding the supply-constrained US market.

items.title: Quality Power arm Mehru bags Rs 15.7 cr Hitachi Energy orders for 400 kV instrument transformers
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy India awarded Mehru Electrical & Mechanical Engineers multiple orders for 400 kV instrument transformers totalling ~₹15.70 cr (ex-tax), execution over ~12 months — EHV component supply chains staying busy.

items.title: POWERGRID wins ~$267m (Rs 2,368 cr) Vindhyachal–Varanasi ISTS-TBCB — new 765 kV AIS substation at Prayagraj
items.snippet: Power Grid Corp emerged successful bidder for the inter-state TBCB scheme building a new 765 kV air-insulated substation at Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh), linked to the Vindhyachal Pooling Station (Madhya Pradesh) via a 220 km 765 kV double-circuit line; 24-month completion. PGCIL's fourth ISTS-TBCB win in FY26 — fresh 765 kV EHV transformer, reactor and accessory pull into India's order pipeline.

items.title: RK Infra Electricals wins Rs 164.74 cr Karnataka 220/66/11 kV substation — two 150 MVA + two 20 MVA transformers
items.snippet: RK Infra Electricals secured a ₹164.74 cr order to build a 220/66/11 kV substation at Sirivara (Kodimuddanahalli), Karnataka, including two 150 MVA and two 20 MVA power transformers — fresh EHV/HV transformer, bushing, OLTC and insulation scope into India's state-grid pipeline.

items.title: POWERGRID wins Rs 1,618 cr Kakinada green-hydrogen ISTS — new 765/400 kV GIS substation + STATCOM (LoI 12 Jun 2026)
items.snippet: Power Grid Corp emerged successful bidder for the inter-state transmission system serving proposed green-hydrogen / green-ammonia projects at Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh — scope includes a new 765/400 kV gas-insulated substation, STATCOM and associated 765 kV lines (LoI received 12 Jun 2026). Fresh 765 kV EHV transformer, reactor, GIS and accessory pull into India's order pipeline.

items.title: Indo-Tech Transformers secures Rs 91.26 cr NTPC order
items.snippet: Indo-Tech Transformers (Prolec-GE group) won a ₹91.26 cr order for NTPC projects — adds power-transformer and accessory scope, reinforcing the OEM's growing thermal/renewable-evacuation order book.

items.title: CG Power emerges L1 for NTPC 3×800 MW Telangana STPP Stage-II power-transformer package
items.snippet: CG Power & Industrial Solutions is the lowest bidder (L1) for the power-transformer package on NTPC's 3×800 MW Telangana Super Thermal Power Project Stage-II — a large GSU / power-transformer scope advancing toward award. Adds to CG Power's already full EHV order book.

items.title: POWERGRID wins WR-ER Inter-Regional Network Expansion (Part-A) under TBCB — LoI 16 Jun 2026
items.snippet: POWERGRID received the Letter of Intent (16 Jun 2026) for the WR-ER Inter-Regional Network Expansion Scheme Part-A under tariff-based competitive bidding — a new inter-regional corridor that pulls fresh EHV transformer, reactor and substation demand into India's order pipeline.

items.title: Transformers & Rectifiers (India) wins Rs 228 cr GETCO grid order
items.snippet: TRIL secured a ₹228.26 cr Gujarat Energy Transmission Corp (GETCO) order — six power transformers + two reactors, phased execution to Aug 2028 — supporting Gujarat's renewable-integration transmission upgrades. Adds to TRIL's long-term order book.

items.title: PGCIL bulk award: CG Power Rs 3.17bn, Siemens Energy India Rs 3.16bn
items.snippet: 765 kV & 400 kV class transformers and reactors split between CG Power and Siemens Energy India under POWERGRID's bulk procurement.

items.title: BHEL wins Rs 3,618m 765 kV transformer package from PGCIL
items.snippet: 17 units of 765/400 kV, 500 MVA single-phase transformers (Package TTR-15/BULK), awarded 23 Dec 2025.

items.title: Atlanta Electricals wins Rs 285 cr Punjab (PSTCL) transmission order
items.snippet: 23 units of 160 MVA, 220/66 kV power transformers with NIFPES fire-prevention systems plus optional spares for Punjab State Transmission Corp; aggregate ~₹285.15 cr incl. taxes. Atlanta also cleared PGCIL for 400 kV-class at its Vadod plant and posted FY26 revenue +49% to ₹1,851 cr (now debt-free).

items.title: TARIL becomes first Indian-origin company to win an HVDC transformer order
items.snippet: Transformers & Rectifiers (India) secured its first HVDC transformer order — a milestone moving an Indian maker into the highest-value EHV/HVDC class historically dominated by Hitachi Energy, Siemens and GE.

items.title: CEA orders strict adherence to standard specs for transformers & reactors ≥66 kV
items.snippet: In a directive (letter dated 24 Jan 2026, reiterated mid-June), India's Central Electricity Authority told utilities and gencos to strictly follow standard specifications for all transformers and reactors rated 66 kV and above — a standardisation push that tightens accessory, insulation and bushing spec requirements across new Indian orders.

items.title: GE Vernova T&D India wins 'massive' PGCIL order — 70+ EHV transformers & shunt reactors
items.snippet: GE Vernova chosen by POWERGRID to supply 70+ EHV transformers and shunt reactors (765 kV class) for TBCB renewable-evacuation corridors — believed to be one of its largest India electrification intakes; deliveries 2026 through end-2027.

items.title: Hitachi Energy India wins Rs 6.47bn PGCIL order for 765 kV transformers
items.snippet: 30 units of 500 MVA, 765/400 kV single-phase transformers, to be built at Maneja, Gujarat — supports renewable integration on India's UHV grid.

items.title: Alfa Transformers wins Rs 63 cr MGVCL order for 12,000 distribution transformers
items.snippet: 11/0.433 kV three-phase 10 kVA aluminium-wound DTs with CRGO or amorphous cores for Madhya Gujarat Vij Company (June 2026).

items.title: Marsons gets PGCIL approval to supply up to 132 kV
items.snippet: Manufacturing unit approved for POWERGRID projects up to 132 kV (disclosed 15 May 2026).

items.title: PGCIL approves Rs 914 cr for cold spare transformers & reactors
items.snippet: Board cleared Rs 913.99 crore for procurement of cold spare transformers and reactors — grid-resilience stockpiling that adds bulk transformer demand on top of project awards.

items.title: CG Power wins major PGCIL bulk EHV order — 765 kV Package 7TR-12
items.snippet: CG Power & Industrial Solutions secured POWERGRID's 765 kV transformer Package 7TR-12-Bulk worth ~Rs 641 crore — another large EHV bulk award keeping India's UHV transformer order books full.

items.title: GE Vernova wins two Stromnetz Berlin substation contracts — SF₆-free g3 GIS at Wittenau & Neukölln
items.snippet: GE Vernova will design, deliver and install two new high-voltage substations for Berlin's DSO using SF₆-free g3 gas-insulated switchgear from its GRIDEA portfolio — the eco-gas substation shift reaching one of Europe's largest urban grids.

items.title: SSEN Transmission + National Grid award BAM the EGL3 converter-station civils (ECI)
items.snippet: Early Contractor Involvement contract for first-phase civil works at the Eastern Green Link 3 converter stations — site enablement ahead of valve-hall and converter-transformer installation on one of the UK's biggest transmission builds.

items.title: First steel cut for 50Hertz Ostwind 4 offshore converter platform (525 kV Baltic HVDC)
items.snippet: Drydocks World began fabricating the converter-station topsides for Germany's first 525 kV Baltic Sea HVDC connection — the platform will house the offshore converter transformers.

items.title: Friedrich Vorwerk wins H2Coastlink 1 — tie-in for EWE's 320 MW Emden electrolyser
items.snippet: ARGE wins the ~24 km Emden–Leer high-pressure H₂ line connecting the electrolyser to Germany's core network; works start this summer, handover autumn 2027 — electrolyser grid-connection scope moving to construction.

items.title: Amprion delays BalWin1 2 GW HVDC North Sea connection to 2031
items.snippet: One-year slip citing converter-platform design challenges and ground conditions — shifts delivery windows for the associated converter transformers and HVDC equipment.

items.title: Baltic Power delivers first electricity — Poland's first offshore wind farm energised
items.snippet: 1.14 GW project exported first power via its offshore substation — energisation milestone for the transformer/substation chain on the Polish Baltic grid.

items.title: SGB-SMIT takes majority stake in COMEL Transformatori (Serbia) — European capacity consolidation
items.snippet: SGB-SMIT signed with Comel Ltd. Belgrade to acquire a majority stake in the Serbian power-transformer maker, expanding its European manufacturing network; closing expected H2 2026 — Tier-2 European capacity is being rolled up while lead times stay long.

items.title: Siemens Energy to rebrand as ‘Omterra’
items.snippet: Europe's largest grid-equipment supplier announced it will rebrand as Omterra — a naming change with practical follow-through for tender documents, vendor registrations and brand approvals across GCC utility approved-vendor lists.

items.title: KONČAR opens $23m high-voltage testing laboratory in Zagreb
items.snippet: New HV test lab inaugurated 14 Jul 2026 strengthens independent European transformer type/routine testing capacity — relevant while third-party test slots (KEMA, CESI class) remain a bottleneck for OEMs and buyers.

items.title: SSEN Distribution awards ~£300m ($400m) north-of-Scotland network renewal frameworks
items.snippet: Aureos Energy, IES Utilities, Ipsum Group and NDS win 5-year (+3 option) frameworks to renew overhead networks across northern Scotland — sustained UK distribution refurbishment demand incl. pole-mounted transformer scope.

items.title: APG invests €300m in Umspannwerk Wien Südost — 'Vienna's biggest power socket'
items.snippet: Austrian Power Grid investiert 300 Mio. € in den Ausbau des Umspannwerks Wien Südost, des wichtigsten Netzknotens Ostösterreichs — Teil des ~€9 Mrd. APG-Investitionsprogramms bis 2035 (€680m allein 2026). Frische Großtransformator- und Zubehörnachfrage im österreichischen Übertragungsnetz.

items.title: France: June heatwave cut power to ~335,000 households — RTE launches preventive replacement of strategic transformers
items.snippet: Pendant la canicule du 19–27 juin 2026, une trentaine de coupures localisées ont privé d'électricité ~335 000 foyers; RTE programme dès 2026 le remplacement préventif de transformateurs stratégiques dans le cadre de son plan ~100 Md€ (2025–2040). Heat-stressed fleets are becoming a European replacement-demand driver.

items.title: Siemens Energy bags ~$4bn EGL4 contract — two HVDC converter stations for the 2 GW Scotland–England link
items.snippet: SP Energy Networks and National Grid Electricity Transmission confirmed Siemens Energy to deliver the Fife (Scotland) and Norfolk (England) converter stations for the £2.5bn Eastern Green Link 4; construction from 2029, operational 2033 — heavy converter-transformer scope locked in.

items.title: German analysis: 2026 large-power-transformer market 'illiquid' — Western lead times 120–150 weeks, GOES up ~100% since 2020
items.snippet: Deutsche Marktanalyse: 2026-Lieferslots für Leistungstransformatoren sind faktisch nicht verfügbar, Tier-1-Auftragsbücher voll; global LPT market ~$32.6bn in 2026, capped by production capacity rather than demand — pricing power stays with OEMs and their supply chain.

items.title: TenneT €1.9bn substation framework (Siemens, Hitachi, GE Grid, Royal SMIT)
items.snippet: Framework covers 160 power transformers + 110 compensation coils for Germany (€1.16bn) and Netherlands (€730m). Multi-year, extendable — ongoing call-offs.

items.title: Amprion launches tender for decentralised grid booster projects
items.snippet: German TSO Amprion opens procurement for grid-booster storage projects supporting transmission capacity.

items.title: DNV launches power transformer joint industry project
items.snippet: Industry collaboration addressing power transformer reliability and supply pressures across Europe.

items.title: RTE awards €1.5bn EPCIC contract to Smulders (Eiffage)
items.snippet: French TSO RTE awarded a €1.5bn engineering, procurement, construction, installation & commissioning package — part of France's grid-reinforcement build-out that keeps European HV transformer order books full.

items.title: GE Vernova–Seatrium win TenneT North Sea HVDC grid connection
items.snippet: Major contract to connect North Sea wind power to Germany's grid under TenneT's 2 GW programme; works commence from January 2026 — sustained European HV transformer pull.

items.title: Hitachi Energy delivers first low-carbon copper transformer to TenneT Germany
items.snippet: 380 MVA unit (Bad Honnef plant) installed at Hardebek near Hamburg — 18% lower embedded copper emissions; ~9,500 t CO₂ saved across the frame agreement. Bad Honnef expansion completes 2026.

items.title: National Grid completes £12bn HVDC supply-chain framework awards
items.snippet: UK HVDC civil-works and equipment frameworks confirmed — locks in converter/transformer supply chain for The Great Grid Upgrade.

items.title: Siemens Energy to build new 2-GW-class North Sea converter platform for 50Hertz — transformers from Nuremberg
items.snippet: Siemens Energy mit Neptun/Smulders baut eine 2-GW-Konverterplattform für 50Hertz in der Nordsee; die Transformatoren kommen aus Nürnberg, die SF6-freie GIS aus Berlin. New 2-GW HVDC link converting offshore wind ~200 km west of Sylt — sustained German HV transformer and GIS pull with domestic value-add.

items.title: German grid operators say transformers are becoming a bottleneck for grid expansion
items.snippet: ZfK reports that key grid components, notably transformers, are turning into a bottleneck for German grid expansion, with utilities (Stadtwerke) and distribution network operators facing long procurement lead times as reinforcement work accelerates. The article highlights how transformer supply constraints are shaping network planning and purchasing decisions.

items.title: Billion-euro order for an offshore wind grid-connection platform in Germany
items.snippet: Energynewsmagazine reports a billion-euro order for a wind-power platform in Germany, part of the country's offshore grid connection build-out. The contract underscores the scale of investment in offshore converter infrastructure needed to connect North Sea wind farms to the onshore grid.

items.title: Mitnetz Strom earmarks EUR 531 million for grid expansion, digitalisation and resilience in 2026
items.snippet: German distribution system operator Mitnetz Strom announced investments of EUR 531 million for 2026, earmarked for grid expansion, digitalisation and resilience measures. The programme reflects continued reinforcement of the German distribution network as renewable capacity and electrification grow.

items.title: RTE transports a transformer for the future 'Les Îles' substation by exceptional convoy
items.snippet: RTE carried out an exceptional heavy-transport operation to deliver a transformer for the future 'Les Îles' substation. The delivery illustrates the logistics involved in installing large power transformers as the French transmission grid is reinforced with new substations.

items.title: French regulator CRE approves RTE's EUR 4.24 billion investment programme for 2026
items.snippet: France's energy regulator CRE approved RTE's 2026 investment programme of EUR 4.24 billion, consistent with the trajectory set in the TURPE 7 transmission network tariff decision. The approval backs sustained spending on the French transmission grid, including substations and network reinforcement.

items.title: RHODÉ consortium launches major R&D project for floating HVDC connection of deep-water offshore wind
items.snippet: RTE and its partners launched the RHODÉ consortium, a major R&D project developing floating HVDC electrical connection technology for offshore wind farms in deep waters. The initiative targets grid-connection solutions for wind parks located beyond the reach of conventional bottom-fixed converter platforms.

items.title: GE Vernova posts $7.1 billion in electrification orders
items.snippet: GE Vernova reported $7.1 billion in electrification orders, reflecting sustained demand for grid equipment as utilities invest in transmission infrastructure. The result highlights the continuing global upswing in grid, transformer and related electrical-equipment spending.

items.title: Red Eléctrica expands Magallón substation in Zaragoza province to reinforce Spain's transmission grid
items.snippet: Red Eléctrica de España is expanding the Magallón substation in Zaragoza province as part of efforts to boost industrial development and reinforce the transmission (transport) grid in the area. The project strengthens supply capacity for the surrounding region in northeastern Spain.

items.title: Terna and STEG award €770m Elmed converter-station contract to Hitachi Energy
items.snippet: Terna and Tunisian TSO STEG awarded Hitachi Energy the €770 million tender for the converter stations of the Elmed interconnection between Italy and Tunisia, billed as the first power link between Europe and Africa. The scope covers the HVDC converter stations, the grid-equipment core of the project, including converter transformers and power-electronics systems. The award confirms Hitachi Energy as lead supplier for the two terminal stations.

items.title: Tyrrhenian Link: Terna completes last of three exceptional transformer transports to Termini Imerese converter station
items.snippet: Terna completed the last of three exceptional (maxi) road transports of large transformers to the Termini Imerese conversion station for the Tyrrhenian Link HVDC project, which will connect Sicily, Sardinia and Campania. The oversized transformer loads had to be moved on special convoys, marking a logistics milestone for the converter-station build-out. The station is a key node of the 500 kV-class HVDC link under construction.

items.title: Slovenian TSO ELES and Terna sign agreement to upgrade Slovenia–Italy cross-border connection (€250m, +600 MW)
items.snippet: ELES and Terna signed an agreement to upgrade the electricity interconnection between Slovenia and Italy along the Divača–Sredipolje–Padriče corridor, with coverage reporting an investment of about €250 million and roughly 600 MW of additional transfer capacity. The upgrade is aimed at grid resilience and more stable operation of both transmission systems. It represents a cross-border grid-reinforcement program in which Terna acts as co-investor with a neighbouring TSO.

items.title: Terna: €1.5bn of grid investments in H1 2026 (+19.8%), with a record second quarter (+41.3%)
items.snippet: Terna reported €1.5 billion of investments in the first half of 2026, up 19.8% year-on-year, with the second quarter setting a record (+41.3%), according to its interim results. The capex is largely directed at developing and reinforcing the national transmission grid, including new lines, stations and HVDC links. The figure confirms acceleration of Terna's multi-year investment plan on electricity infrastructure.

items.title: Terna starts authorization process for €80m grid interventions in Milan province
items.snippet: Terna launched the authorization process for interventions on the electricity transmission network in the province of Milan, with an investment of about €80 million. The works target the renewal and reinforcement of the transmission network serving the metropolitan area. The announcement is part of Terna's ongoing program to upgrade high-voltage infrastructure around major Italian cities.

items.title: Terna launches authorization process for a new electrical substation in Pisa province
items.snippet: Terna started the authorization process for building a new electrical substation in the province of Pisa, a project aimed at strengthening the regional transmission grid. The new station is intended to improve network resilience and support the connection of new generation in the area. The authorization route involves the Italian Ministry of the Environment and Energy Security (MASE).

items.title: Terna brings new eastern Sicily connection into service, completing the Paternò–Pantano–Priolo line
items.snippet: Terna made operational a new connection that strengthens the electricity grid of eastern Sicily, with Quotidiano Energia reporting completion of the new Paternò–Pantano–Priolo line. The infrastructure increases redundancy and supply security for the area. The commissioning is part of Terna's regional transmission investments in Sicily.

items.title: Pennsylvania Transformer delivers fourth 225 MVA / 138 kV unit to Texas data-centre campus
items.snippet: ~370,545 lb unit moved 1,375 miles by rail — fourth identical LPT for the same campus; sustained data-centre-driven large-power-transformer demand now being met by US domestic makers.

items.title: Siemens Energy starts construction of $300m grid-equipment plant in Pearl, Mississippi
items.snippet: New US campus for HV switchgear / grid-stability equipment (up to 300 jobs + training centre) — the US grid-manufacturing build-out extends beyond transformers into the wider substation supply chain.

items.title: DOE closes up to $3.26bn loan to AEP Texas — ~100 transmission projects, up to 41 GW of new load
items.snippet: Energy Dominance Financing loan (announced 8 Jul) backs ~100 transmission projects/upgrades spanning ~2,800 miles incl. reconductoring and new lines; AEP Texas has agreements supporting up to 41 GW of potential new load through 2030 (data centres, Permian) — more funded US transmission means more transformer purchase orders into an already tight market.

items.title: LUMA energises three new power transformers in Puerto Rico — orders placed years ahead due to lead times
items.snippet: New units at Sabana Llana (Carolina), Crea (Bayamón) and Mora (Isabela) substations serve ~782,500 customers, funded via DOE/FEMA; LUMA notes utilities must now order transformers years in advance — a live example of US lead-time reality.

items.title: US power companies scramble to secure transformers, turbines and switchgear as AI data-centre demand strains supply
items.snippet: AP/Reuters (9 Jul 2026): US utilities and data-centre developers are competing for scarce transformers, turbines and switchgear as AI-driven load outpaces reshored supply; GSU transformer lead times passed 160 weeks in Q1 2026 (vs ~143 in 2024) and large-power-transformer waits now run 3–5 years, lifting equipment prices an expected ~4–10% over the next year — the import/allocation window for non-US suppliers with capacity stays wide open.

items.title: Hitachi Energy building the largest US power transformer factory — $457m in South Boston, Virginia, for the AI power boom
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy's $457m Virginia plant — billed as the largest power transformer factory in the US — targets AI/data-centre-driven grid demand, part of its >$1bn US grid-manufacturing package; online 2028.

items.title: Trench Group commits to US grid build-out: 765 kV CVT project won for Texas; $60m Charlotte HSP bushing plant opens Jul 2026
items.snippet: Trench Group announced a 765 kV capacitive-voltage-transformer award supporting ERCOT's first 765 kV transmission lines in Texas, alongside the July 2026 grand opening of its $60m Buy-America-compliant HSP transformer-bushing factory in Charlotte, NC — instrument-transformer & bushing supply chain localising for the US EHV push.

items.title: Transformer and breaker backlogs persist despite reshoring progress
items.snippet: Despite ~$2bn directed toward North American transformer production expansion (new capacity online by 2028), backlogs for transformers and breakers persist as demand keeps outpacing reshored supply — the import window for non-US suppliers stays open.

items.title: US transformer lead times extend to four years
items.snippet: Actual order data shows 128-week (≈2.5 yr) waits before a unit ships; high-capacity power transformers stretching to 4 years.

items.title: GSU transformer demand up 274% (2019–2025); imports = 80% of supply
items.snippet: Imports cover ~80% of US power transformer supply and 50% of distribution supply — structural domestic production gap.

items.title: ~$2bn directed to North American transformer capacity (online by 2028)
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy, Siemens Energy and others expanding, but new capacity won't relieve the current shortage before 2028.

items.title: US buyers scramble for imports and factory slots
items.snippet: Utilities and developers competing for import allocations and production slots as domestic order books fill — opportunity window for non-US suppliers with capacity.

items.title: Over half of planned US data centers face delay on transformer & switchgear shortage
items.snippet: More than 50% of US data centers planned for 2026 expected delayed or cancelled for lack of step-down transformers and electrical gear.

items.title: Brazil: Taesa's R$1.55bn takeover of five Energisa transmission companies approved — ANEEL clears transfer
items.snippet: Taesa's AGE approved the R$1.545bn acquisition of five Energisa transmission SPCs in Goiás, Pará and Tocantins (aquisição de cinco concessionárias de transmissão) — ~4,494 MVA of transformation, 12 substations and 1,305 km of lines (per Atlas Público); ANEEL prior consent via Despacho 2.609, closing within 120 days — Brazilian transmission assets keep consolidating.

items.title: Brazil: WEG wins compensating-solution package for Vilhena 2 500/230 kV substation — 165 MVA transformer + 165 MVAr syncon
items.snippet: WEG firma contrato com a Guaporé Sul Transmissora (BTG Pactual) — full 'solução compensadora' for the Vilhena 2 substation under Lot 4 of ANEEL Auction 04/2025: a 165 MVAr synchronous compensator, a 165 MVA three-phase transformer, auxiliary transformers, panels and protection systems, strengthening the Acre–Rondônia subsystem.

items.title: China XD wins CNY 4.13bn in SGCC third-batch UHV & transmission equipment tenders — 14 subsidiaries named
items.snippet: 中国西电7月22日公告：下属14家子公司中标国家电网2026年特高压项目第三次设备招标及输变电项目第三次变电设备招标，合计约41.29亿元 — UHV packages ~CNY 2.63bn (transformers, converter valves, capacitors, breakers, disconnectors) + T&D packages ~CNY 1.50bn (transformers, reactors, GIS, instrument transformers, arresters). China's third-batch UHV procurement wave is now converting into awards — domestic order books extend further into 2027.

items.title: Egypt: EETC signs two more contracts to tie the new Samannoud 500/220/66 kV substation into the national grid
items.snippet: وقعت المصرية لنقل الكهرباء عقدين مع مؤسسة النماء للمقاولات العامة لفتح وربط الخط الهوائي المزدوج (زفتى القديمة/الجديدة) 500/220/66 ك.ف باتجاه محطة محولات سمنود الجديدة — 2×10 كم لكل عقد بنظام تسليم المفتاح مع OPGW، تنفيذ 8 أشهر. EETC keeps letting turnkey tie-in packages around its new EHV substations — a steady 500 kV-class transformer and accessory pipeline next door to the GCC.

items.title: Egypt: EETC signs two substation contracts in a week — El-Tor 220/66/11 kV GIS (Kharafi National) + Beni Khaled 66/11 kV grid tie-in
items.snippet: المصرية لنقل الكهرباء وقعت عقدين: محطة محولات الطور الدائمة بجهد 220/66/11 ك.ف من النوع المعزول بالغاز (GIS) بنظام تسليم المفتاح مع الخرافي ناشيونال (16 يوليو، تنفيذ 15 شهراً، منطقة كهرباء القناة/سيناء)، وعقد ربط محطة محولات بني خالد الجديدة 66/11 ك.ف بالشبكة القومية مع تحالف العالمية تاور والعربية الأفريقية (20 يوليو، 5 أشهر). Egypt's EETC keeps letting turnkey GIS substation and tie-in packages — fresh 220 kV-class transformer, GIS and accessory scope next door to the GCC.

items.title: SGCC's eight UHV equipment batches total CNY 40.79bn — converter transformers CNY 7.6bn across 14 packages
items.snippet: 八批特高压设备招标累计407.9亿元、667个包、156家供应商：换流阀112.1亿（NARI系46.8%）、1000 kV GIS 77.7亿、换流变76.0亿 — XD, NARI, Shandong Electrical, TBEA and five others take ~80% of value; converter-transformer prices reported rising as the UHV wave builds.
items.src: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 2 Jul 2026 [zh]

items.title: Orica's Hunter Valley Hydrogen Hub confirmed at FID — Plug Power to deliver 50 MW PEM electrolyser (Australia)
items.snippet: First Hydrogen Headstart project into execution: 50 MW PEM unit at Kooragang Island, ~4,700 t H₂/yr replacing ~7.5% of site gas use, A$432m ARENA support — rectifier-transformer and grid-connection scope to follow.

items.title: Japan: transformer price listings resume as third-tier Top Runner efficiency units start full shipment
items.snippet: July 2026 'Kensetsu Bukka' issue resumes transformer price listings as OEMs begin full shipments of transformers meeting the third-tier Top Runner efficiency standard — a repricing marker for the Japanese distribution-transformer market.
items.src: Kensetsu Bukka Chosakai · Jul 2026 [ja] · date unverified

items.title: Sumitomo Electric + Van Oord sign long-term HVDC framework with SSEN Transmission for Shetland 2 (525 kV)
items.snippet: 住友電気工業とVan OordがSSEN Transmissionと長期枠組み契約 — consortium starts early design/engineering for the Shetland–mainland 525 kV subsea HVDC link; cable order planned 2026, production from Q2 2027 at Sumitomo's >£350m Nigg (Scotland) plant. Japanese HVDC supply chain embedding into the UK grid build.

items.title: Korea's power trio keeps landing hyperscaler orders — HD Hyundai Electric ₩1.12tn Big Tech framework, LS Electric ~₩170bn AWS deal
items.snippet: 한국 전력기기 3사의 미국 데이터센터 수주 행진 — Invest Chosun details HD Hyundai Electric's long-term Big Tech master agreement (distribution ₩553.9bn + power equipment ₩567.3bn, deliveries through 2028), Hyosung Heavy's ₩310bn AusNet deal and LS Electric's ~₩170bn AWS switchgear win with five DC orders in Q2 — Korean EHV/distribution slots locking up with hyperscalers; open capacity for other buyers keeps shrinking.

items.title: Mexico (CFE) energises new 75 MVA transformer at Turbogás Los Cabos substation, Baja California Sur
items.snippet: La CFE energizó el 5 de julio de 2026 un transformador de 75 MVA en la subestación Central Turbogás Los Cabos (bahía nueva de 115 kV), como salida de una nueva unidad generadora — parte de la ampliación de la Red de Transmisión del Noroeste; beneficia a ~399,648 usuarios. Fresh Mexican transmission-transformer commissioning as CFE rolls out its 58-project 2026–27 transmission portfolio (~2,800 MVA in Bloque 1 alone).

items.title: Astor Enerji signs TL 816.2m TEİAŞ contract — four mobile transformer substations + four MV units
items.snippet: TEİAŞ'ın 4 adet mobil trafo merkezi ve 4 adet OG ünitesi (yedek malzemeler dahil) ihalesini kazanan Astor Enerji, 816,2 milyon TL'lik sözleşmeyi 2 Temmuz 2026'da imzaladı — rapid-deploy mobile substation capacity for Türkiye's transmission grid; Astor's order book keeps swelling ahead of its second Ankara factory.

items.title: Rosseti lifts 2026 investment programme to RUB 857bn — 18 GVA of new transformer capacity planned this year
items.snippet: «Россети» увеличивают инвестпрограмму 2026 года до 857 млрд руб.; на 2026 год запланирован ввод 18 ГВА трансформаторной мощности против 15,2 ГВА в 2025 — sustained Russian demand for power transformers and components across the federal grid.

items.title: HD Hyundai Electric signs ₩1.02tn (~$750m) long-term data-centre power-infrastructure deal with a global big-tech firm
items.snippet: HD현대일렉트릭, 글로벌 빅테크와 1조212억원 규모 데이터센터 전력 인프라 장기 공급계약 — contract runs 2 Jul 2026 to Jan 2029; ultra-high-voltage transformers ₩567.3bn plus distribution transformers ₩553.9bn. Korean EHV makers locking multi-year capacity directly with hyperscalers — slots for other buyers tighten further.

items.title: SGCC 8th-batch UHV equipment tender: CNY 1.7bn of reactors split among 7 firms — Energy China leads with 39.4%
items.snippet: 国网第八批特高压设备招标：电抗器约17亿元由7家企业分食 — 中国能建39.4%居首、经纬正能38.2%、特变电工18%、思源2.8%。China's UHV second-batch 2026 procurement (>CNY 20bn total) keeps rolling into individual equipment awards — domestic UHV order books stay full into 2027.
items.src: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 2 Jul 2026 [zh]

items.title: Brazil: ANEEL auctions lots 7–10 of Transmission Auction 1/2026 — Axia Energia takes 3 of 4 lots, R$1.8bn secured
items.snippet: Na segunda sessão do Leilão 1/2026 (3/7, B3), a Axia Energia venceu os lotes 8 (MS), 9 (SP) e 10 (Cuiabá/MT); os 4 lotes somam R$1,8 bi em investimentos, 61 km de novas linhas e +2.400 MVA de transformação em SP, MS e MT — fresh Brazilian substation-transformer scope on top of the R$3.3bn first tranche.

items.title: Hitachi Energy wins €770m Elmed converter-station contract — first Europe–Africa HVDC link (Italy–Tunisia)
items.snippet: Terna and STEG awarded Hitachi Energy ~€770m to build the Partanna (Sicily) and Mlaabi (Tunisia) converter stations for the 600 MW, 220 km Elmed interconnector — the first DC link between Europe and North Africa, with heavy converter-transformer scope.
items.src: Africa Mining Insight / Offshore Energy · 30 Jun 2026 [en]

items.title: Hyosung Heavy wins ₩310bn (~$225m) 5-year UHV transformer & reactor supply deal with Australia's AusNet
items.snippet: 효성중공업, 호주 빅토리아주 송전망 운영사 AusNet과 5년 독점 공급계약 — 초고압 변압기·리액터, 약 3,100억원 규모 — its second big Australian win this year; Korean EHV makers extending beyond the US into Australia's transmission build.

items.title: Brazil Northeast UHV DC project starts full-line construction — State Grid's third overseas UHV scheme
items.snippet: 巴西东北部特高压直流输电项目全线开工 (26 Jun 2026) — SGCC's third overseas UHV project after Belo Monte I & II, moving Northeast wind/solar south; major converter-transformer and EHV equipment pipeline in Brazil.

items.title: Linxon wins $80m for four turnkey 132/33 kV GIS substations in Iraq
items.snippet: For Iraq's Ministry of Electricity under the JICA-financed Electricity Sector Reconstruction Project.

items.title: Siemens Energy to build five 400 kV HVDC substations across Iraq
items.snippet: Iraq's General Company of Electrical Energy Transmission signed a strategic agreement with Siemens Energy for five HV substations — 400 kV units in Baghdad, Diyala, Najaf, Karbala and Basra — strengthening the national transmission backbone.

items.title: Iraq Ministry of Electricity to procure 4,026 locally-made transformers
items.snippet: Large domestic transformer order strengthening the national grid and local industry — localization signal.

items.title: Linxon signs three contracts to rehabilitate 400 kV BSP stations in Iraq
items.snippet: Iraq's Ministry of Electricity contracted Linxon for rehabilitation of three critical 400 kV bulk-supply-point stations — rehab scope means transformer overhaul, accessories and insulation demand rather than only new-build.

items.title: Jordan–Iraq electricity interconnection substation works to conclude in 2026
items.snippet: Cross-border 400 kV interconnection substation works expected to wrap during 2026 (NEPCO).

items.title: Siemens wins 132 kV GIS substation contract in Iraq
items.snippet: Supply of electrical equipment and civil works for several 132 kV gas-insulated substations.

items.title: Brazil signs Transmission Auction 1/2026 concessions in June — 4,350 MVA of new transformation
items.snippet: ANEEL homologated Leilão 1/2026 (R$3.3bn, 798 km of lines and ~4,350 MVA of transformation across 11 states); Lote 1 signed 3 Jun and lots 2/3/4/5 on 26 Jun — incl. the 230/69 kV Nossa Senhora da Glória II SE with two 150 MVA transformers. Lots 2/4/5 + group-3 sublots signed 26 Jun; second tranche (lots 7–10) set for 3 Jul — continuous EHV equipment pipeline.

items.title: Brazil's Tangará project: four new 500 kV transformers enter operation
items.snippet: Santa Luzia III transformers energised, strengthening the North–Northeast grid in Maranhão and Pará alongside a 500 kV line upgrade.

items.title: Record 820-t HVDC transformer ships from Sweden to China
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy's record-breaking HVDC VSC transformer leaves Sweden for the Gansu–Zhejiang UHV transmission project — global UHV demand keeps top-end capacity booked.

items.title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 14 subsidiaries win CNY 1.447bn of State Grid procurement (transformers, switchgear, UHV equipment)
items.snippet: China XD Electric (中国西电) announced that 14 of its subsidiaries jointly won State Grid (国家电网) procurement tenders totaling CNY 1.447bn. The award covers power-grid equipment including transformers and switchgear, underscoring continued State Grid purchasing of high-voltage apparatus from domestic manufacturers.
items.src: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 30 Dec 2025 [zh]

items.title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 6 subsidiaries win CNY 1.899bn of State Grid UHV project procurement
items.snippet: China XD Electric said six of its subsidiaries won State Grid procurement worth CNY 1.899bn for UHV (特高压) projects. The award extends the company's streak of large grid-equipment orders, consistent with accelerating State Grid UHV and AC/DC transmission construction.
items.src: Dahe Cube 大河财立方 · 12 Jun 2026 [zh]

items.title: 平高电气 Pinggao Electric: wins CNY 876m of State Grid procurement (GIS/switchgear)
items.snippet: Pinggao Electric (平高电气) announced it won State Grid procurement tenders worth about CNY 876m. The listed switchgear maker's award reflects sustained State Grid spending on HV switchgear and related substation equipment.

items.title: 许继电气 XJ Electric: wins about CNY 1.245bn of State Grid UHV projects
items.snippet: XJ Electric (许继电气) disclosed it won State Grid UHV-related procurement totaling about CNY 1.245bn. The order book adds HVDC/UHV control-protection and converter-related equipment work for the State Grid network, per its voluntary disclosure announcement.
items.src: East Money 东方财富 · 23 Jul 2026 [zh]

items.title: 保变电气 Baoding Tianwei Baobian Electric wins 500kV main transformer supply for Hebei Lingshou pumped-storage station
items.snippet: Baobian Electric (保变电气) won the procurement of 500kV three-phase two-winding oil-immersed water-cooled power transformers for the Hebei Lingshou pumped-storage hydropower station. The order highlights demand for large power transformers in pumped-storage and grid-ancillary projects.

items.title: 特变电工 TBEA: bid-evaluation result for main transformers of Jinsha River upper-reach Changbo hydropower station
items.snippet: TBEA (特变电工) appeared in the bid-evaluation announcement for the main power transformers and auxiliary equipment of the Changbo hydropower station on the upper Jinsha River (Huadian's project). The result is a sign of large-hydro main-transformer supply going to domestic manufacturers.

items.title: Shanbei–Anhui ±800 kV UHVDC transmission project completed and commissioned
items.snippet: Xinhua reported that the Shanbei–Anhui (陕北—安徽) ±800kV ultra-high-voltage DC transmission project entered commercial operation. The line transmits northwest power to the Anhui load center, expanding the UHVDC corridor network that drives demand for converter transformers and converter-valve equipment.

items.title: State Grid: grid construction accelerated across all voltage levels in H1 2026
items.snippet: State Grid Corporation (国家电网) said grid construction at all voltage levels was accelerated in the first half of 2026. The official update signals continued heavy investment in substations, transmission lines and distribution networks — the demand backdrop for transformer, switchgear and UHV equipment makers.
items.src: State Grid 国家电网官网 · 21 Jul 2026 [zh]

items.title: TCN expands Lagos power grid with 840MVA transformer roll-out
items.snippet: Nigeria's Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) is rolling out 840MVA of transformer capacity across Lagos substations, boosting transmission capacity in the country's commercial capital. The programme is part of ongoing reinforcement of the Lagos transmission network.

items.title: KETRACO energises Isinya–Konza 400kV line, boosting grid reliability for Konza Technopolis
items.snippet: Kenya's KETRACO energised the Isinya–Konza 400kV transmission line, strengthening grid reliability and power supply to Konza Technopolis. The line adds high-voltage transmission capacity for the technopolis and the wider Lower Eastern region of Kenya.

items.title: Hitachi Energy adds USD 150m to expand power transformer manufacturing capacity in Latin America
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy announced an additional USD 150 million investment to expand its power transformer manufacturing capacity in Latin America, reaffirming its commitment to the region. The move targets growing demand for large power transformers amid grid expansion and renewable integration across Latin American markets.

items.title: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico proposes 45 transmission expansion projects worth over USD 700m
items.snippet: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional proposed 45 transmission expansion projects with an estimated investment of more than USD 700 million, part of the 2026 transmission planning cycle. The package includes new lines and substation works aimed at reinforcing the national transmission grid.

items.title: CFE strengthens northwestern Mexico's grid with new substation and transmission infrastructure
items.snippet: Mexico's state utility CFE is reinforcing the electrical network of the northwest with new infrastructure, including substation and transmission works. The effort is aimed at improving supply reliability in the region served by CFE's northwestern divisions.

items.title: Dominican Republic's EDEESTE puts new power transformer into operation at Los Minas 138 kV substation
items.snippet: Dominican Republic distribution utility EDEESTE commissioned a new power transformer at its Los Minas 138 kV substation. The unit is part of the distributor's program to reinforce transformation capacity and improve supply reliability in its service area.

items.title: Ecuador's CELEC installs new transformer raising Esmeraldas electrical capacity by 61%
items.snippet: Ecuador's state power company CELEC (Hidronación) installed a new transformer that increases the electrical capacity of the province of Esmeraldas by 61%. The upgrade strengthens transformation capacity in the coastal region.

items.title: Peru's MINEM optimizes transmission projects to reinforce national grid security and reliability
items.snippet: Peru's Ministry of Energy and Mines (MINEM) announced it is optimizing electrical transmission projects as part of efforts to reinforce the security and reliability of the national electricity system. The measures touch on the planning of transmission lines and related grid infrastructure.

items.title: Colombia's ANLA approves second environmental license modification for 500 kV La Loma–Sogamoso transmission line
items.snippet: Colombia's National Environmental Licensing Authority (ANLA) approved the second modification of the environmental license for the La Loma–Sogamoso 500 kV transmission line. The 500 kV project is part of Colombia's high-voltage transmission expansion to integrate generation and reinforce the national grid.

items.title: CPFL Paulista invests over R8m to expand and modernize Piracicaba 2 substation
items.snippet: CPFL Paulista invested more than R8 million in the expansion and modernization of the Piracicaba 2 substation in São Paulo state, increasing the energy capacity available to the region. Substation works of this type typically include replacement or addition of power transformers, bays and protection equipment. The project is part of CPFL's distribution-grid reinforcement program in the interior of São Paulo.

items.title: Toshiba Energy Systems wins HVDC order to renew Pole 1 of J-Power Transmission Network's Hokkaido–Honshu link
items.snippet: Toshiba Energy Systems & Solutions (東芝エネルギーシステムズ) received an order from J-Power group's 電源開発送変電ネットワーク for the renewal of Pole 1 of the Hokkaido–Honshu interconnection, covering design, procurement and installation of self-commutated AC/DC converter equipment comprising converters, transformers and control/protection devices. The ~167 km HVDC link (600 MW total, 300 MW per pole) between Hakodate and Kamikita converter stations has operated since 1979. Equipment delivery starts from FY2029, with operation planned during FY2031.
items.src: 東芝エネルギーシステムズ ニュースリリース · 16 Mar 2026 [ja]

items.title: Toshiba Energy Systems to invest ~JPY 55bn in transmission/distribution equipment output; Hamakawasaki and India capacity to double by FY2030
items.snippet: Toshiba Energy Systems & Solutions announced ~JPY 55bn of production investment in its transmission/distribution equipment business through FY2027 — about JPY 35bn on top of the ~JPY 20bn announced in July 2024 — targeting its Hamakawasaki Works (Kawasaki) and Indian subsidiary TTDI. Production capacity at both sites is to more than double by FY2030 versus FY2024. The expansion covers transformers, switchgear and arresters, citing grid renewal, renewables expansion and data-center demand.
items.src: 東芝エネルギーシステムズ ニュースリリース · 17 Oct 2025 [ja]

items.title: Hitachi Energy announces record ~JPY 48bn China investment to expand transformer capacity at Hefei subsidiary
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy (日立エナジー) announced on 17 Aug 2026 a strategic investment of about USD 300 million (~JPY 48bn) in China — described as its largest single investment in the country — at its Hefei transformer subsidiary, marked by completion of a digital tap-changer production line and groundbreaking of an ultra-high-voltage bushing project. The investment extends its power transformer business and component manufacturing to strengthen its global supply network amid surging transformer demand.

items.title: Daido Japan wins distribution transformer orders at JECA FAIR 2026 with 2026 Top Runner-compliant T-NEX series
items.snippet: Daido Japan (大同日本, a TATUNG subsidiary) exhibited at JECA FAIR 2026 (the 74th electrical installation industry fair, May 2026) and announced its T-NEX high-efficiency mold transformer series conforming to Japan's 2026 Top Runner transformer standard, while disclosing it won multiple distribution transformer orders before and after the fair. The company cites rapidly rising demand for high-efficiency equipment ahead of full enforcement of the 2026 Top Runner standard.
items.src: 時事ドットコム（PR TIMES配信）· 6 Jul 2026 [ja]

items.title: Hokkaido Electric Power Network (北電ネット) to build new substations in Ishikari and Tomakomai for data-center demand
items.snippet: Hokkaido Electric Power Network plans to construct new substations in Ishikari and Tomakomai to accommodate rising electricity demand from data centers entering the region. The substation build-out is part of the utility's grid infrastructure response to load growth.
items.src: 北海道新聞デジタル · 30 Mar 2026 [ja]

items.title: Grid council (広域機関) sets Chugoku–Kyushu transmission reinforcement plan, targeting March 2039 operation
items.snippet: The Organization for Cross-regional Coordination of Transmission Operators (電力広域的運営推進機関) formulated a plan to reinforce the Chugoku–Kyushu transmission interconnection (中国九州間連系設備), aiming for operation start in March 2039. The plan was filed with METI in mid-October 2025 as a wide-area grid development plan (広域系統整備計画), underpinning cross-regional grid investment.
items.src: 中国新聞デジタル · 15 Oct 2025 [ja]

items.title: TEPCO Power Grid solicits land for 500 kV substations in Tokyo, Ibaraki and Chiba to serve data-center demand
items.snippet: Tokyo Electric Power Grid (東電PG) began soliciting land for new substations — EHV substations (275–500 kV/154 kV) around Tsukuba, Ibaraki and Kashiwa, Chiba, plus intermediate and distribution substations near central Tokyo stations — as a second solicitation round following December 2024. The company plans to build 2–3 new 500 kV/154 kV substations by 2040, enabling acceptance of 6–9 GW of additional data-center and industrial demand.
items.value: 500 kV/154 kV · 6–9 GW DC demand by 2040

items.title: Hitachi to invest over JPY 150bn in US, including new transformer plant for data centers
items.snippet: Nikkei reports Hitachi is investing more than JPY 150bn in the United States, including a new transformer plant oriented to data-center demand. The move reflects growing US power-equipment demand and transformer supply tightness.

items.title: LS Electric wins ~KRW 100bn ultra-high-voltage transformer order from US big-tech client
items.snippet: Yonhap reports LS Electric (LS일렉트릭) secured an ultra-high-voltage (EHV) transformer order worth about KRW 100bn from a major US technology company. The deal extends the Korean equipment maker's exposure to AI-driven US data-center power demand and adds to its transformer backlog. The customer and delivery terms were not disclosed.

items.title: Iljin Electric wins KRW 120bn EHV transformer order for Canadian data centers
items.snippet: Iljin Electric (일진전기) announced a transformer supply contract worth about KRW 120bn for Canadian data centers, per Yonhap. The order underscores the trend of Korean power-equipment makers capturing AI/data-center-driven demand in North America.

items.title: HD Hyundai Electric raises 2026 order target 23% to about KRW 8tn on global grid demand
items.snippet: HD Hyundai Electric (HD현대일렉트릭) lifted its 2026 order target by about 23% to roughly KRW 8tn, citing strong global demand for power infrastructure tied to AI and electrification, per Donga Bizn. Transformer and switchgear backlogs continue to expand as US and European grid investment rises.

items.title: KEPCO to build third transmission line and undersea grid link for Incheon Yeongjong after blackouts
items.snippet: After large-scale blackouts on Incheon's Yeongjong Island, KEPCO (한국전력) is pushing ahead with a third transmission line plus an undersea transmission route, with about KRW 35.4bn to be invested, per Yonhap and Herald Economy coverage. The reinforcement adds redundancy to the island's power supply after repeated outage incidents.

items.title: Hitachi Energy inaugurates USD 70m power transformer factory and service center in Dilovası, Türkiye
items.snippet: Hitachi Energy opened a new power transformer factory and service center in Dilovası, Kocaeli, backed by a USD 70m investment, per the company's Turkish-language press release. The facility strengthens Türkiye's transformer manufacturing base for domestic supply and exports.

items.title: TEİAŞ publishes 2,000 MWe of transformer-based unlicensed generation capacity for 2026
items.snippet: TEİAŞ published its 2026 allocation of a total 2,000 MWe of unlicensed electricity generation capacity to be assigned at distribution level on a transformer basis, announced via GENSED. The scheme ties new distributed-generation connections to available transformer capacity at substations.

items.title: Egypt's electricity minister: EGP 37bn for developing and upgrading the transmission grid
items.snippet: Egyptian Electricity Minister Mahmoud Esmat announced EGP 37bn of investments to support, develop and modernize the transmission network and raise its capacity to absorb new renewable generation, per Masrawy. The program targets grid reinforcement as renewables and new capacity connect to the system.
